passages.text: Then the LORD said to Joshua, “Tell the Israelites to designate the cities of refuge, as I instructed you through Moses, so that anyone who kills another unintentionally or accidentally may flee there. These will be your refuge from the avenger of blood.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Joshua.
The LORD gave Joshua a command.
The LORD told Joshua to speak to the Israelites.
The LORD told Joshua to say this to the Israelites.
The LORD said, “Set apart the cities of refuge.
I spoke about these cities to you through Moses.
These cities are for people who kill someone by accident.
These cities are for people who kill without meaning to.
Anyone who kills another person unintentionally may run to these cities.
These cities will protect them from the avenger of blood.”
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ לֵאמֹֽר׃ דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר תְּנ֤וּ לָכֶם֙ אֶת־ עָרֵ֣י הַמִּקְלָ֔ט אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶ֖ם בְּיַד־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃ לָנ֥וּס שָׁ֙מָּה֙ רוֹצֵ֔חַ מַכֵּה־ נֶ֥פֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָ֖ה בִּבְלִי־ דָ֑עַת וְהָי֤וּ לָכֶם֙ לְמִקְלָ֔ט מִגֹּאֵ֖ל הַדָּֽם׃

passages.text: When someone flees to one of these cities, stands at the entrance of the city gate, and states his case before its elders, they are to bring him into the city and give him a place to live among them.
passages.sermon:
A person may kill another person by accident.
God told the Israelites to set apart special cities for such people.
These cities are called cities of refuge.
If someone kills by accident, he must run to one of these cities.
He must go to the entrance of the city gate.
He must stand there.
He must speak to the elders of that city.
He must tell them what happened.
The elders must listen to him.
The elders must bring him into the city.
They must give him a place to stay.
He must live among them.
passages.original: וְנָ֞ס אֶל־ אַחַ֣ת׀ מֵהֶעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה וְעָמַד֙ פֶּ֚תַח שַׁ֣עַר הָעִ֔יר וְדִבֶּ֛ר בְּאָזְנֵ֛י זִקְנֵ֥י־ הָעִֽיר הַהִ֖יא אֶת־ דְּבָרָ֑יו וְאָסְפ֨וּ אֹת֤וֹ הָעִ֙ירָה֙ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וְנָתְנוּ־ ל֥וֹ מָק֖וֹם וְיָשַׁ֥ב עִמָּֽם׃

passages.text: Now if the avenger of blood pursues him, they must not surrender the manslayer into his hand, because that man killed his neighbor accidentally without prior malice.
passages.sermon:
The avenger of blood may pursue the manslayer.
The avenger of blood wants to punish the manslayer.
The people of the city must not hand over the manslayer to the avenger of blood.
The manslayer killed his neighbor by accident.
The manslayer did not hate his neighbor before.
The manslayer did not plan to kill his neighbor.
The killing happened without intention or malice.
passages.original: וְכִ֨י יִרְדֹּ֜ף גֹּאֵ֤ל הַדָּם֙ אַֽחֲרָ֔יו וְלֹֽא־ יַסְגִּ֥רוּ אֶת־ הָרֹצֵ֖חַ בְּיָד֑וֹ כִּ֤י בִבְלִי־ דַ֙עַת֙ הִכָּ֣ה אֶת־ רֵעֵ֔הוּ וְלֹֽא־ שֹׂנֵ֥א ה֛וּא ל֖וֹ מִתְּמ֥וֹל שִׁלְשֽׁוֹם׃

passages.text: He is to stay in that city until he stands trial before the assembly and until the death of the high priest serving at that time. Then the manslayer may return to his own home in the city from which he fled.”
passages.sermon:
The manslayer must stay in that city.
He must remain there until he stands trial before the assembly.
He must also stay until the high priest serving at that time dies.
After the high priest dies, the manslayer may return home.
He may go back to his own city.
He may return to the place from which he fled.
passages.original: וְיָשַׁ֣ב׀ בָּעִ֣יר הַהִ֗יא עַד־ עָמְד֞וֹ לִפְנֵ֤י הָֽעֵדָה֙ לַמִּשְׁפָּ֔ט עַד־ מוֹת֙ הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּד֔וֹל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִהְיֶ֖ה בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֑ם אָ֣ז׀ יָשׁ֣וּב הָרוֹצֵ֗חַ וּבָ֤א אֶל־ עִירוֹ֙ וְאֶל־ בֵּית֔וֹ אֶל־ הָעִ֖יר אֲשֶׁר־ נָ֥ס מִשָּֽׁם׃

passages.text: So they set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron) in the hill country of Judah.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites set apart three cities.
They set apart Kedesh in Galilee.
Kedesh is in the hill country of Naphtali.
They set apart Shechem.
Shechem is in the hill country of Ephraim.
They set apart Kiriath-arba.
Kiriath-arba is also called Hebron.
Hebron is in the hill country of Judah.
passages.original: וַיַּקְדִּ֜שׁוּ אֶת־ קֶ֤דֶשׁ בַּגָּלִיל֙ בְּהַ֣ר נַפְתָּלִ֔י וְאֶת־ שְׁכֶ֖ם בְּהַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וְאֶת־ קִרְיַ֥ת אַרְבַּ֛ע הִ֥יא חֶבְר֖וֹן בְּהַ֥ר יְהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: And beyond the Jordan, east of Jericho, they designated Bezer on the wilderness plateau from the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead from the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan from the tribe of Manasseh.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites set apart cities of refuge.
They did this for people east of the Jordan River.
This area is east of Jericho.
They chose Bezer in the wilderness plateau.
Bezer belonged to the tribe of Reuben.
They chose Ramoth in Gilead.
Ramoth belonged to the tribe of Gad.
They chose Golan in Bashan.
Golan belonged to the tribe of Manasseh.
passages.original: וּמֵעֵ֜בֶר לְיַרְדֵּ֤ן יְרִיחוֹ֙ מִזְרָ֔חָה נָתְנ֞וּ אֶת־ בֶּ֧צֶר בַּמִּדְבָּ֛ר בַּמִּישֹׁ֖ר מִמַּטֵּ֣ה רְאוּבֵ֑ן וְאֶת־ רָאמֹ֤ת בַּגִּלְעָד֙ מִמַּטֵּה־ גָ֔ד וְאֶת־ גָּלוֹן בַּבָּשָׁ֖ן מִמַּטֵּ֥ה מְנַשֶּֽׁה׃

passages.text: These are the cities appointed for all the Israelites and foreigners among them, so that anyone who kills a person unintentionally may flee there and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood prior to standing trial before the assembly.
passages.sermon:
God appointed special cities for the Israelites.
God also appointed these cities for foreigners living among the Israelites.
Anyone who killed a person by accident could run to these cities.
The person who killed by accident could find safety there.
The avenger of blood could not kill the person who fled to the city.
The person who killed by accident would not die before standing trial.
The person would stand before the assembly for judgment.
passages.original: אֵ֣לֶּה הָיוּ֩ עָרֵ֨י הַמּֽוּעָדָ֜ה לְכֹ֣ל׀ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְלַגֵּר֙ הַגָּ֣ר בְּתוֹכָ֔ם לָנ֣וּס שָׁ֔מָּה כָּל־ מַכֵּה־ נֶ֖פֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָ֑ה וְלֹ֣א יָמ֗וּת בְּיַד֙ גֹּאֵ֣ל הַדָּ֔ם עַד־ עָמְד֖וֹ לִפְנֵ֥י הָעֵדָֽה׃פ
